SYLPHX_AUTH_URL.description: Exact HTTPS origin of the Auth API, injected by Hosting.

LOCKDOCS_GOOGLE_ADS_ID.description: Optional public Google Ads destination ID. Requires LOCKDOCS_GOOGLE_ADS_PURCHASE_LABEL.

LOCKDOCS_GOOGLE_ADS_PURCHASE_LABEL.description: Optional public Google Ads purchase action label. Requires LOCKDOCS_GOOGLE_ADS_ID.

LOCKDOCS_TENANT_AUTH_ORIGIN.description: Exact verified HTTPS Account Portal origin for custom OAuth providers. Omit for shared provider credentials.

SYLPHX_MONEY_API_KEY.description: Server credential injected via Hosting Secret Binding; Ads settlement verification requires billing:read in addition to checkout creation.
